english:
Scoring 2 Glaive Melee Kills within 3 seconds grants 2 Reserve Ammo to Special Ammo Glaives.

Has a 2 second cooldown between activations.

Blocking damage with a Glaive Shield grants <pve 85% /> <pvp [?%] /> increased Glaive Melee Damage for 6.5 seconds.

Also triggers if an ally shoots the Shield.

source.text:
Upon scoring 2 Glaive Melee Kills within 3 seconds of each:
+2 Reserve Ammo to Special Ammo Glaives.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown between activations.

Upon blocking damage with a Glaive Shield:
85% [?%] increased Glaive Melee Damage for 6.5 seconds.
Also triggers if an Ally shoots the shield.
